svg.aria-label: A Kani run ends as verified, falsified, cover unsatisfied, cancelled or inconclusive. Only a falsified run returns a counterexample, which codegen replays through FSL: the result is a reproduced violation, or an evidence failure when the counterexample is not valid evidence.
